name: River of Sorrow and Hope
source:
Anisha and Julian are in love. On one dark and stormy night something unexpected happens. Will their love prevail? How is it even possible for it to continue?

[From [url=https://lavinnia.itch.io/river-of-sorrow-and-hope]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阿妮莎与朱利安彼此相爱。然而，在一个漆黑、风雨交加的夜晚，意外发生了。他们的爱情能够战胜一切吗？这段感情，又要如何继续下去？

[摘自[url=https://lavinnia.itch.io/river-of-sorrow-and-hope]Itch.io[/url]]
